tokens.name: sakura-red
tokens.usage: Brand colour, sampled from the logo artwork: the mark, wordmark, headings, links and primary buttons. Text on white (13.8:1), blush-light (12.2:1) and blush (9.4:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primary page ground and the base of cards, header and footer. Text on it: ink, sakura-red, warm-charcoal, rose.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and UI text on white and the blush panels (16.5:1 on white, 14.5:1 on blush-light, 11.2:1 on blush).

tokens.name: warm-charcoal
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on white (7.6:1) and blush-light (6.6:1).

tokens.name: blush-light
tokens.usage: Soft panels, input backgrounds and section bands on a white page. Carries ink, warm-charcoal, sakura-red or rose text.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Dividers, borders, hover fills and pattern tints; also the favicon in dark mode. Text on it: ink (11.2:1) or sakura-red (9.4:1).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Small accent: highlights, icons, decorative marks, notices. Text on white (6.6:1) and blush-light (5.8:1); never use it as a ground for the red logo.

tokens.name: on-sakura-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sakura-red fill, such as primary buttons and the reversed logo (13.8:1).

families.display: "AR Mincho", "Shippori Mincho", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.label: "Agrandir Wide", "Lexend Giga", "Montserrat", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero wordmark-style headline, one per page. sakura-red on white.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page and section headlines, sentence case.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions, form notes and legal text in warm-charcoal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, buttons and tags, set in capitals; echoes the NAILS line of the logo (Agrandir Wide, stood in for by Lexend Giga).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding inside inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between stacked items.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding and the petal-pattern pitch.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons; half the short side of the control.
